headline: North-West's WH-07 conveyor breakdown drove the SLA drop to 88.3%.
body: North-West alone fell 13 points while other regions held roughly flat, matching the regional concentration flagged upstream. The conveyor failure on June 25 cut sortation throughput to 60% and left the site short 14 pickers, which lines up with delivery delays and two enterprise customers citing missed SLAs in North-West [E5]. A competitor's new 2-day express launch in the same region is a secondary factor worth checking but has weaker support and no direct evidence tying it to volume loss yet.

actions.driver: WH-07 conveyor failure and picker shortage
actions.action: Route North-West overflow volume to 3PL immediately
actions.expected_impact: Restore SLA toward baseline within 1-2 weeks
actions.monitoring: Track North-West daily SLA % and dispatch delay times

actions.action: Fill the 14 open picker roles at WH-07
actions.monitoring: Track WH-07 throughput and staffing headcount weekly

what_could_change: Confirmation of conveyor repair completion date or evidence linking SwiftKart's launch to actual volume diversion would sharpen this.
caveats: The competitor launch hypothesis is unstructured and not yet corroborated with volume-loss data; causation is not established.
